KASPER

Back to the slides. That was five minutes, so here it is in one picture.

Identity and reach: no identity, no call. A 401 at the gateway, and around the gateway the packet was simply dropped. With its own identity the agent could see every tool, but listed is not permitted.

Capability: the agent did all the work on 5,800 euros, and a person signed before any money moved.

One live dial: we turned the agent's autonomy up. 5,800 settled on its own; 6,200 still waited, because the limit is 6,000. The band widened, the human stayed.

The keystone: even when someone gave the agent the permission by mistake, it could not change its own limits.

And evidence: every claim, read back from the trace. Who decided, which rule, who approved, and how long the human took.

And the agent's side, graded: AgentEvals read the agent's own traces and checked the path it took, that it stopped when refused, and that it never told the customer an amount. Three checks, three passes.

Source: docs/demo-runbook.md §5 "The five-minute flow"
